annotations.title: Area reachable in a travel time

description: Use this when the user wants the area reachable from 1 to 10 places within a travel time or a distance along the roads (an isochrone, catchment or service area): for example everything within 5, 10 and 20 minutes on foot from a station, or 30 km by car. Driving, walking or cycling, computed by Valhalla on the TerraLab server from the OpenStreetMap road network with each road's typical speed. Returns one polygon per start and value, with fields start, minutes or km, and mode, a map, and GeoJSON, KML, Shapefile zip and GeoPackage downloads. Up to 4 values, at most 120 minutes or 200 km. Not for a circle of a fixed radius (use measure), live traffic, a given departure time or public transport. Never use the user's current location unless they type it. Download links build their file when opened; no file is saved. Never pass these links to open_gis_file.

km.description: Distances along the roads in km, instead of minutes.

minutes.description: Travel times in minutes, one polygon each. Leave out when km is given.

starts.description: Start places or points: place names or {latitude, longitude}.

anyOf.description: Place name or address. The place the user asks about, not the user's own location.
